top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Provide enough nursing staff every day to meet the needs of every resident; and have a licensed nurse in charge on each shift.
Ensure that feeding tubes are  not used unless there is a medical reason and the resident agrees; and provide appropriate care for a resident with a feeding tube.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure food and drink is palatable, attractive, and at a safe and appetizing temperature.
Address subsistence needs for staff and patients.
